description: Defines the CellRange class for handling ranges of cells in a spreadsheet, including validation and address calculations.

classes.name: CellRange
classes.description: Represents a range of cells in a spreadsheet, with methods for validation and string representation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a CellRange with start and end cell addresses, validating their order.

methods.name: validateFromTo
methods.description: Ensures the 'from' and 'to' addresses are correctly ordered and within the same worksheet.

methods.name: validateWorksheets
methods.description: Checks that the worksheets of the cell addresses are in the same spreadsheet and support 3D ranges.

methods.name: cellAddressWrapper
methods.description: Creates a wrapped CellAddress object with methods to navigate cells.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Returns the starting CellAddress of the range.

methods.name: to
methods.description: Returns the ending CellAddress of the range.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the cell range, e.g., 'A1:B2'.
